label: SQLite via drift (on-device)
notes: Every schema change bumps `schemaVersion` and adds a step to `MigrationStrategy.onUpgrade`; a shipped step is never edited.
Export each version with `dart run drift_dev schema dump` into `drift_schemas/` and test the upgrade path from every shipped version with the generated schema tests.
Data lives on the user's device: a destructive step cannot be repaired from a server, so it is reversible or explicitly accepted with a data-loss note.
There is no row-level security on device; the device owner owns the data, and sync code enforces the server's rules.
Generated `*.g.dart` files are rebuilt, never hand-edited.
